decision_conditions: The existing development does not constitute Lawful Development under Section 191 of Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Section 191 as amended by Section 10 of the Planning and Compensation Act 1991, as the Applicant has not sufficiently demonstrated that, on the balance of probability, the conversion of the property from a dwelling (Use Class C3) to a small HMO (Use Class C4) occurred prior to 11.12.2025 - the date that the Council's immediate Article 4 Direction to remove Permitted Development rights borough-wide for such conversions came into effect.

Weighing all available evidence, it is considered that on the balance of probabilities, the conversion of the application property from C3 to C4 Use very likely took place after 11.12.2025. As such, this conversion would not have benefitted from Permitted Development rights and would therefore not have been lawful. Planning permission for the conversion would therefore be required.
description: Confirmation of use of the property as a C4 HMO (Application for a Certificate of Lawful Development for an Existing Development)
